description: Context Budget Alerts - Alert when project tokens exceed configured LLM context limits with suggestions
steps: Add budget calculation logic to lib/utils/llm-detector.js with warning thresholds (80%, 90%, 100%)
Add suggestion generation for large files to exclude
Integrate budget alerts into bin/cli.js with --target-model flag
Update token-calculator.js to use budget analysis
Add colored console output for warnings
acceptance_criteria: --target-model flag allows model selection (claude-sonnet-4.5, gpt-4o, gemini-2.0-flash, etc.)
Context window utilization percentage is displayed
Suggestions show which files can be excluded
verification: Run npm test and confirm all tests pass
Test CLI with --target-model flag and verify budget output
Test with different models and verify correct context windows
findings: Successfully implemented Context Budget Alerts feature. Added warning thresholds (80% warning, 90% critical, 100% overflow) with colored ANSI output. Added file suggestion generation that shows the largest files that could be excluded to reduce context. The feature integrates with existing --target-model flag and shows the percentage of total context window used. Tests were updated to match the new output format. All 953 tests pass.
